LevelTimeTracker.readme:
Level Time Tracker ⏱️ See how long every level takes, on every character, in World of Warcraft: Midnight and World of Warcraft: Forever. 🧭 Introduction
Level Time Tracker times every level you gain, to the second, and keeps the times of all your characters. It counts time the way /played does: all the time you are logged in on a character, and never the time you spend logged out. It even times the level you are on when you install it, because the game tells it how long you have already played that level.

LoZN64.readme:
LoZN64 | Legend of Zelda LevelUp!
This addon replaces the default level-up sound in World of Warcraft with the iconic looting chest sound from *The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time*. Note: You can still hear the sound even if all other game sounds are disabled — as long as the “Enable Sounds” option is turned on.
--- 🎵 Features - Disables the default level-up sound. - Adds the classic Zelda looting chest sound for level-ups.
--- 🚀 Quick Start
The addon is enabled by default — just install and enjoy the new level-up sound!

FishKeeper.readme:
FishKeeper
Retail World of Warcraft fishing tracker. Counts every catch, lists what you hooked, and prices the haul with TradeSkillMaster.
Game: Retail (Midnight, interface 120100 / 120105) Optional: TradeSkillMaster for auction values Author: frostaphim Install
1. Close World of Warcraft. 2. Copy the FishKeeper folder into World of Warcraft/_retail_/Interface/AddOns/. 3. Restart WoW and enable FishKeeper at the character select addon list. 4. Install TradeSkillMaster if you want AH prices. Without TSM, vendor sell is used.
The folder name must be FishKeeper (next to the .toc file). Window

AntiSocial.readme:
AntiSocial Minimal human interaction, maximum efficiency.
A tiny WoW addon for players who'd rather not deal with the social parts of the game. Two features in one: Auto-messages on game events
Fires randomized chat messages with a 1-8 second (default) delay when: - You join a party or raid (says hi) - You leave a group (says ty) - A group member earns an achievement (gz) - A group member levels up (gz) - A Mythic+ key completes (gg / unlucky depending on timed vs depleted) - A ready check pops (auto-confirms, off by default) Whisper filter
